tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (first stop of the body gradient). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: color-antique-gold
tokens.usage: Primary metal, numismatic prestige, coin surfaces,. Used as text on `.logo`, `.stat-value`, `.card-price`. 3.1:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-rich-gold
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo:hover`, `.nav-link:hover`, `.table-title`. 2.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-patina-green
tokens.usage: Natural oxidation, copper patina,. Used as text on `.stat-trend`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-velvet-burgundy
tokens.usage: Coin presentation boxes, velvet-lined cases,. Used as text on `.page-title`, `.section-title`, `.form-title`. 9.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-archive-cream
tokens.usage: Catalog paper, archival documentation, aged vellum,. Used as text on `.nav-link`, `.btn-secondary`, `.footer-section p, .footer-section a`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-deep-bronze
tokens.usage: Antique frames, aged wood, display cases, classical. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-title`, `.card-title`. 8.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-coin-silver
tokens.usage: Silver currency metals, tarnish tones, secondary.
